How do users formulate searches when the.answer_markdown:
Users primarily formulate searches using keywords (n=50, 27.5%) or by browsing/scrolling (n=34, 18.7%) when their memory is incomplete, while 34.6% (n=63) did not state a specific search behavior. The style table covers n=182 episodes, so the evidence is not thin. The most common specific type is keyword search.

-  Keyword search is the most common specific style with n=50 (27.5%), followed by browse_scroll with n=34 (18.7%).
-  A significant portion of users (n=63, 34.6%) had 'none_stated' search behavior, indicating no specific search method was described.
